eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, I want an appointment with Dr. Hartman at Arenal Centro.
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Laura Ruiz Gomez born the 14th of September 1978.
Ficha encontrada: Laura R. (por fecha de nacimiento y nombre)
Sin gestión · ese médico no es de la casa
Thank you, Laura, I have your record here. I'm sorry, we don't have a Dr. Hartman at the clinic. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
